title: 宝可梦剧场版官方频道深度专访：总监督汤山邦彦谈〈光轮的超魔神 胡帕〉、传说宝可梦大决战与全设定画精选
dek: 上映前夕，汤山邦彦分四部分谈短片音乐尝试与传说宝可梦大战。
excerpt: PocketMonsters.net 2015年刊出汤山邦彦导演上映前四部分专访，谈短片《皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》用叫声做音乐的尝试，以及《光环的超魔神 胡帕》中传说宝可梦大战、胡帕的设定与迪拜取景。

segments.original: "Pokémon the movie XY: The Archdjinni of Rings - Hoopa/Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians" finally premieres this weekend!
segments.translation: 《宝可梦剧场版XY 光环的超魔神 胡帕／皮卡丘与宝可梦乐队》本周末终于要上映了！

segments.original: To commemmorate this, we will hold a special interview with Director Yuyama about the movies' highlights, subjects, etc. There will be four parts in all!
segments.translation: 为纪念上映，我们将对汤山导演进行特别专访，请他谈谈电影的看点、主题等。专访共分四部分！

segments.original: The two first parts of the interview will focus on the short, "Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians"!
segments.translation: 专访的前两部分将聚焦短片《皮卡丘与宝可梦乐队》！

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: The story is described as "For the first time ever! A musical performance using Pokémon cries!", so it's obvious it has a music theme. What kind of movie is it?
segments.translation: 故事被描述为“史上首次！用宝可梦的叫声进行的音乐演奏！”，所以显然是以音乐为主题。这是一部怎样的电影呢？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: "Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians" is actually something I've been wanting a chance to make since all the way back when the Pocket Monsters TV series first began.
segments.translation: 《皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》其实是我从《宝可梦》电视系列刚开始的时候就想找机会做的东西。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Back when the TV series first began and we decided to have all the Pokémon have individual cries, then got the voice actors to provide these Pokémon voices, I found the "sound" of the cries really interesting.
segments.translation: 电视系列刚开始的时候，我们决定让所有宝可梦都有各自的叫声，然后让配音演员来发出这些宝可梦的声音，当时我觉得这些叫声的“声音”非常有趣。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Right from the get-go, I started thinking about whether we could use these sounds to create music.
segments.translation: 从一开始，我就开始想能不能用这些声音来创作音乐。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Even though the thought had entered my mind, though, I really didn't know what would be the best way to go about it.
segments.translation: 不过，虽然这个想法进入了我的脑海，但我真的不知道最好的实现方式是什么。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: As such, it wasn't until this year I decided to finally do this thing.
segments.translation: 因此，直到今年我才决定终于来做这件事。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: However, I couldn't really just explain to the production staff how the entire "create music with cries" idea was going to work. So we did a demo, an "initial template" so to speak, by getting the voice actors to sing Pokémon cries, then when we heard something we thought worked, we added that to the scenario.
segments.translation: 然而，我没办法只靠说明就让制作人员明白“用叫声创作音乐”这个想法整体要怎么运作。所以我们做了一个小样，可以说是“初始模板”，让配音演员唱出宝可梦的叫声，然后当我们听到觉得可行的东西时，就把它加进剧本里。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Doing a musical that used nothing but Pokémon voices is something I really wanted to do, but seriously... being in the planning stage for over 10 years?
segments.translation: 做一部只用宝可梦声音的音乐剧，是我真的很想做的事，但说真的……在企划阶段待了超过10年？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: If you go by when I first thought of the idea, this movie has been in the works for 19(?) years now (laughs)
segments.translation: 如果从我第一次想到这个主意的时候算起，这部电影到现在已经做了19(?)年了（笑）

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: This short has a somewhat different feel to it than previous shorts! Could you tell us some details about the production and the trial-and-error process it went through?
segments.translation: 这部短片的感觉和之前的短片有些不同！能告诉我们一些关于制作以及它经历的反复试错过程吗？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: We made this short in a completely different way from how we've made previous ones.
segments.translation: 我们制作这部短片的方式，和以往制作短片的方式完全不同。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: First and most importantly, we had to record the voices in advance.
segments.translation: 首先也是最重要的，是我们必须提前录制声音。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Usually we do the dubbing at the very end, after everything else is done, but this time we had to start off by recording the singing to first create the initial template demo, then a demonstration version. We didn't just record once either, we did it at least 3 times, then used those recordings to create the template that would be used for the demo...
segments.translation: 通常我们是在所有其他工作都完成之后，最后才进行配音，但这次我们必须一开始就录制演唱，先做出最初的模板小样，然后是示范版本。而且我们不是只录一次，至少录了3次，然后用这些录音来制作用于小样的模板……

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: This time we made songs for the short itself, ones that went with the scenario.
segments.translation: 这次我们为短片本身创作了歌曲，是与剧情相配的。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: That meant we had to draw the Pokémon singing along to this song to get it properly lip-synced. The recording of the singing for these drawings then got split into 3 or 4 parts.
segments.translation: 这意味着我们必须画出宝可梦跟着这首歌演唱的画面，才能让口型对得准确。为这些画面录制的演唱随后被分成了3到4个部分。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: This time only the actual acting to the finished animation got recorded like normal, while the singing was recorded separately, in two or three portions.
segments.translation: 这次只有配合完成动画的实际表演部分像平常一样录制，而演唱则是分开录制的，分成两三个部分。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: We've never done anything like this ever before!
segments.translation: 我们以前从来没有做过这样的事！

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Every time you try something for the first time, you end up fumbling around not really knowing your way around.
segments.translation: 每次你尝试新东西，最后都会手忙脚乱，不太清楚该怎么做。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Week in and week out, we noticed things that needed to be done, started working on that material, and then as we were doing so, we'd discover something else that needed to be done as well.
segments.translation: 一周又一周，我们注意到有需要做的事情，就开始着手处理那些材料，而在做的过程中，又会发现还有别的事情也需要做。

segments.original: To be continued in part 2!<
segments.translation: 未完待续，见第2部分！<

segments.original: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama #2 (2015/7/15)
segments.translation: 汤山导演电影首映前特别访谈 #2（2015/7/15）

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.original: We are interviewing Director Yuyama about "Pokémon the movie XY: The Archdjinni of Rings - Hoopa/Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians", which premieres this weekend!
segments.translation: 我们正在就本周末首映的《宝可梦剧场版XY：光环的超魔神 胡帕／皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》采访汤山导演！

segments.original: In this second part, we ask him about production secrets regarding "Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians"!
segments.translation: 在第二部分中，我们向他询问关于《皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》的制作秘闻！

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: We heard that because this is "Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians", almost all the music is made up of the sounds of Pokémon voices?
segments.translation: 我们听说，因为这是《皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》，几乎所有的音乐都是由宝可梦的叫声构成的？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: For that reason, the movie doesn't have a score, yes.
segments.translation: 正因如此，这部电影没有配乐，是的。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.note: LGM（Little Glee Monster）是日本女子声乐组合，当时演唱了该片的主题曲。
segments.original: For the title sequence, we got LGM (Little Glee Monster, performers of the theme song) to sing a cappella, so while this is the only scene in the movie with a score, the score here is nothing but voices too, consisting purely of a chorus.
segments.translation: 片头部分，我们请LGM（Little Glee Monster，主题曲演唱者）进行了无伴奏合唱，所以虽然这是电影中唯一有配乐的场面，但这里的配乐也全是人声，纯粹由合唱构成。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Since the Pokémon are "Musicians", there are parts where they each act as specific instruments, though if we think of their cries as singing, it turns into song. Or rather, vocal percussion.
segments.translation: 既然宝可梦们是“音乐家”，有些部分它们各自充当特定的乐器，不过如果把它们的叫声视为歌唱，那就变成了歌曲。或者说是人声打击乐。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: It's all voices, all through the entire movie.
segments.translation: 整部电影从头到尾全是声音。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: There's sound effects, though.
segments.translation: 不过，有音效。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: What kind of story is "Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians"?
segments.translation: 《皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》是怎样的故事？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: The story concerns a concert being held in concurrence with "Berry Blossoming", this harvest festival-like celebration they have in the Pokémon's forest. However, various trouble occurs, so this quick little story plays out before "Berry Blossoming" can start.
segments.translation: 故事讲的是，在宝可梦森林里举行的类似丰收节的“果实绽放”活动期间，同时举办一场音乐会。然而，发生了各种麻烦，所以在这个小故事中，在“果实绽放”开始之前事情就展开了。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Songs get sung throughout the tale, so it can be enjoyed as a musical.
segments.translation: 整个故事中都会唱歌，所以可以当作音乐剧来欣赏。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: This short seems packed with new things you're trying out, and it's really something to look forward to. Can you say a few words to the audience that are going to be watching "Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians" in the theater?
segments.translation: 这部短片似乎塞满了各种新尝试，非常令人期待。能否对将在影院观看《皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》的观众说几句话？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: The Pokémon are all happily singing together, so I'd like you to sing and dance along in the theater as well.
segments.translation: 宝可梦们都在开心地一起唱歌，所以希望各位也在影院里一起唱、一起跳。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.note: 山本美月是日本的演员、模特，当时担任该短片的旁白。
segments.original: The Narrator, Mizuki Yamamoto, sings along too.
segments.translation: 旁白山本美月也会一起唱。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: It'd make me very happy if I made the children in the theater suddenly burst into song together.
segments.translation: 如果能让影院里的孩子们突然一起唱起歌来，我会非常高兴。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Since even we, the people who made this short, couldn't picture how it would turn out, the audience won't really be able to either. What does Pokémon singing sound like? You're in for a fun surprise at the theater.
segments.translation: 连制作这部短片的我们都无法想象它会变成什么样，观众大概也想象不到。宝可梦唱歌是什么声音？请在影院里享受这份惊喜。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Lots of nostalgic Pokémon will appear in the short too, so there's something else to look forward to!
segments.translation: 短片中还会出现许多令人怀念的宝可梦，这也是值得期待的地方！

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: In part 3, we'll ask about the highlights of the feature film, "The Archdjinni of Rings: Hoopa"!
segments.translation: 第3部分，我们将询问长篇电影《光环的超魔神 胡帕》的看点！

segments.original: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama #3 (2015/7/16)
segments.translation: 汤山导演电影上映前特别采访 #3（2015/7/16）

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.original: Only two days remain until the movie premieres! We're interviewing Director Yuyama about the movies' highlights and subjects, and in this third part, we'll be asking about the feature film, "The Archdjinni of Rings: Hoopa"!
segments.translation: 距离电影上映只剩两天！我们正在就电影的看点和主题采访汤山导演，这第3部分将询问长篇电影《光环的超魔神 胡帕》！

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: What kind of movie is the feature film "The Archdjinni of Rings: Hoopa"?
segments.translation: 剧场版《光环的超魔神 胡帕》是一部什么样的电影？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: First and foremost, it's a movie where lots of legendary Pokemon appear.
segments.translation: 首先，这是一部会有很多传说宝可梦登场的电影。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: You could call this the ultimate concept for a Pokémon movie, and it's what I used as the starting point for this year's installment.
segments.translation: 可以说这是宝可梦电影的终极构想，我把它作为今年这部作品的出发点。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: We were going to have all these legendary Pokémon that have starred in earlier movies appear all together, so figuring out what we were going to have them do was actually really difficult.
segments.translation: 我们打算让此前在历代电影中担任主角的所有传说宝可梦一起登场，所以实际上，要决定让它们做什么非常困难。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: What made it all possible was this year's star Pokémon, Hoopa.
segments.translation: 让这一切得以实现的是今年担任主角的宝可梦胡帕。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: It has this power to retrieve asolutely anything from faraway places using its rings.
segments.translation: 它拥有用圆环从遥远的地方取来任何东西的力量。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: This power was a perfect fit for gathering an entire lineup of legendary Pokémon.
segments.translation: 这种力量与召集一整批传说宝可梦完美契合。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: So this star Pokémon with this special power, Hoopa, what kind of Pokémon is it?
segments.translation: 那么，拥有这种特殊力量的主角宝可梦胡帕，是一只什么样的宝可梦呢？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: While its natural form is the giant "Unbound Form", it's been deprived of its power thanks to this item called the "Prison Bottle" and turned into the cute, small "Confined Form".
segments.translation: 它的本来形态是巨大的“解放形态”，但因为一个叫“惩戒之壶”的道具被夺走了力量，变成了可爱小巧的“惩戒形态”。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: As such, both the big Hoopa and the small Hoopa are, in fact, the same Hoopa.
segments.translation: 因此，大胡帕和小胡帕其实是同一只胡帕。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: The big Hoopa went on a rampage in the past, but rather than it being out of malice, it was more like it was a child that got egged into doing something that escalated way out of control.
segments.translation: 那只巨大的胡帕在过去曾经大肆破坏，但那并非出于恶意，更像是小孩子被人怂恿着去做某件事，结果越闹越大、彻底失控了。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: So when such a Pokémon got turned into its current form, one that feels the same but is so much smaller, it may be a prankster, but it also has this really innocent and honest personality and loves simple fun.
segments.translation: 所以当这样一只宝可梦变成现在这种形态——感觉还是同一个，但小了很多——它可能爱恶作剧，但同时也拥有非常天真坦率的性格，喜欢简单的乐趣。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: However, what's been confined in the Prison Bottle, the "Unbound Form" of Hoopa, acts as Satoshi and his friends' enemy, right?
segments.translation: 不过，被封印在惩戒之壶里的、胡帕的「解放形态」，是作为小智一行人的敌人登场的，对吧？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: What's been confined in the Prison Bottle is Hoopa's true power.
segments.translation: 被封印在惩戒之壶里的，是胡帕真正的力量。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: This power has built up a lot of "anger" due to its confinement.
segments.translation: 这份力量因为被封印，积攒了大量的「愤怒」。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: So this other... Hoopa that's taken the shape of Hoopa, it's sort of like Hoopa's anger that's taken physical form.
segments.translation: 所以这另一个……变成了胡帕模样的胡帕，可以说就像是胡帕的愤怒有了实体。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: And then Satoshi and the real Hoopa fight it, setting up this huge confrontation.
segments.translation: 然后小智和真正的胡帕与它战斗，构成了这场宏大的对决。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: The small Hoopa meets Satoshi and they have an adventure together, so what's the relationship between Satoshi, Pikachu and Hoopa like?
segments.translation: 小胡帕遇到小智，一起经历了一场冒险，那么小智、皮卡丘和胡帕之间的关系是怎样的呢？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Hoopa is this really innocent little kid. However, it's unable to regain its original, true power.
segments.translation: 胡帕就是个非常天真的小孩子。但它无法取回原本真正的力量。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.note: 《酋雷姆VS圣剑士 凯路迪欧》是2012年上映的宝可梦剧场版。
segments.original: So Satoshi shows up and, true to himself, instantly develops this really straight and uncomplicated relationship with it. It's very unlike "Kyurem VS the Sacred Swordsman Keldeo", where Keldeo had a strong sense of duty and went to Satoshi for encouragement, treating him as his elder; here instead, Satoshi's relationship with Hoopa is much more spontaneous and feel kind of like an extension of them just playing together.
segments.translation: 于是小智出现了，他一如既往，立刻就和它建立起非常直率、单纯的关系。这和《酋雷姆VS圣剑士 凯路迪欧》很不一样——那部里凯路迪欧有很强的责任感，把小智当作前辈，去找他寻求鼓励；而这里，小智和胡帕的关系要自然得多，感觉就像是他们一起玩耍的延伸。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: For Hoopa, the events that unfold are not about duty, but instead about doing something together, overcoming difficulties together, building this very straightforward friendship between it and Satoshi.
segments.translation: 对胡帕来说，故事中展开的事件并非关乎职责，而是关乎一起做某件事、一起克服困难，以及它与小智之间建立起的这种非常直接的友谊。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Hoopa is able to make anything and everything "Appear!" from its rings, and while it can use this to make people happy, one of the big themes in the movie is the discovery of important things that can't just be summoned from these rings.
segments.translation: 胡帕能够从它的圆环中让任何东西“出现！”，虽然它可以借此让人们开心，但电影的一大主题是发现那些无法仅凭这些圆环召唤出来的重要事物。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: One of these important things is its relationship with Barza and Mary, which has developed over all the years they've been living together.
segments.translation: 其中一件重要事物就是它与巴尔扎和玛丽之间的关系，这种关系是在他们共同生活的这些年里逐渐发展起来的。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Another of them is Satoshi and his friends.
segments.translation: 另一件就是小智和他的伙伴们。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: You'll get to see whether Hoopa manages to find something important when you watch the movie in the theater.
segments.translation: 胡帕是否设法找到了重要的事物，等你在影院观看电影时就能见分晓。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: In part 4, we will ask for details about the movie's setting and the battle between legendary Pokémon that unfolds there!
segments.translation: 在第4部分中，我们将询问有关电影设定以及在那里展开的传说宝可梦之间战斗的细节！

segments.original: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama #4 (2015/7/17)
segments.translation: 汤山导演电影上映前特别采访 #4（2015/7/17）

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.original: We're interviewing Director Yuyama about the movie's highlights!
segments.translation: 我们正在就电影的精彩看点采访汤山导演！

segments.original: Tomorrow is finally the movie's premiere day!
segments.translation: 明天终于就是电影上映的日子了！

segments.original: The big highlight of "The Archdjinni of Rings: Hoopa" is the "Legend VS Legend" concept!
segments.translation: 《光环的超魔神 胡帕》的一大看点就是“传说VS传说”的概念！

segments.original: We'll now be asking questions regarding this battle between legendary Pokémon and the place where the battle takes place!
segments.translation: 接下来我们要提问的是关于这场传说宝可梦之间的战斗，以及战斗发生的地点！

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: Since the movie is set in a desert city, you went scouting in Dubai, but what kind of place is this Désser City?
segments.translation: 由于这部电影设定在一座沙漠城市，你们曾去迪拜取景，那么戴塞尔城是个什么样的地方？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: The core concept is a place in the middle of a desert filled with hyper-modern skyscapers.
segments.translation: 核心概念是位于沙漠中央、布满超现代摩天大楼的地方。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: That's the kind of place I wanted to have the legendary Pokemon rampage through.
segments.translation: 我就是想让传说宝可梦在那种地方大肆破坏。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: We started looking for places to base it off, and since Dubai is a hypermodern city in the middle of a desert full of skyscrapers, we decided to go there for our scouting.
segments.translation: 我们开始寻找可以作为原型的场所，而迪拜正是一座位于沙漠中央、遍布摩天大楼的超现代城市，于是我们决定去那里取景。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Dubai isn't just a modern city, lots of older parts of the cityscape still remain there as well.
segments.translation: 迪拜不只有现代的一面，城市景观中仍保留着许多古老的区域。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: The movie goes into the particulars of the great rampage Hoopa went on in the past, giving us a story that spans an entire 100 years, so we designed Désser City as a place where different time periods intermingle, making it a part historic and part modern place for legendary Pokémon to appear in.
segments.translation: 电影深入讲述了胡帕过去那场大破坏的细节，呈现了一个跨越整整一百年的故事，因此我们将戴塞尔城设计成一个不同时代交融的地方，既有历史感又具现代感，让传说宝可梦在此登场。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: And what is the city's iconic building, Désser Tower, based on?
segments.translation: 那么这座城市的地标建筑戴塞尔塔，是以什么为原型的呢？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Well, you see there's this giant ring on the top of the building, right?.
segments.translation: 嗯，你看，建筑顶部有一个巨大的圆环，对吧？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: It's not based on any particular building in Dubai, but instead on... a certain Pokémon.
segments.translation: 它并非以迪拜的某座特定建筑为原型，而是以……某只宝可梦为原型。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: You'll find out when you watch the movie.
segments.translation: 看了电影你就会知道。

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: Can you tell us the highlights of this intense battle being referred to as "Legend VS Legend"?
segments.translation: 这场被称为“传说VS传说”的激烈战斗，能告诉我们它的看点吗？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Legendary Pokémon appear in the middle of this city filled with skyscrapers we've modeled after Dubai and a battle beteen them and Satoshi's side unfolds.
segments.translation: 传说宝可梦会出现在这座以迪拜为原型、高楼林立的城市中央，它们与小智一方的战斗就此展开。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: We constructed the city they battle in entirely in 3D, and then you get Satoshi flying through it riding on Latios' back, taking part in this huge dogfight. This battle scene is the one part of the movie we put the most effort into and its absolute highlight.
segments.translation: 它们战斗的这座城市我们完全用3D构建，然后小智骑在拉帝欧斯背上穿梭其中，参与这场大规模的空中缠斗。这场战斗戏是整部电影中我们投入最多心血的部分，也是绝对的看点。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: There's also this sandstorm blowing during this scene.
segments.translation: 这个场景里还有沙尘暴在刮。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.note: 哈利法塔位于阿联酋迪拜，2010年落成，高828米，为世界第一高楼。
segments.original: During our scouting, we went to the top of the Burj Khalifa (*the world's tallest building, at 828 meters), but when we looked down from it, it looked extremely foggy, almost as if a sea of clouds was hanging below us.
segments.translation: 在取景时，我们登上了哈利法塔（*世界最高建筑，高828米）的顶部，但从上面往下看时，那里雾蒙蒙的，几乎像是一片云海悬在我们脚下。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: It turned out this was a sandstorm blowing through.
segments.translation: 原来那是沙尘暴正在刮过。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: It was evening then, and as we were watching the sun go down, I thought it'd be really cool to have the legendaries flying around the scene we were now watching.
segments.translation: 当时是傍晚，我们一边看着太阳落下，一边想，要是让传说宝可梦在我们眼前这片景色中飞翔，那一定会非常酷。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: I think the finished movie scenes that resulted from that carry a real impact.
segments.translation: 我觉得由此完成的电影画面确实很有冲击力。

segments.speaker: PocketMonsters.net
segments.original: Finally, can you say a few words to the audience that are going to be watching the movie in the theater?
segments.translation: 最后，能对即将在影院观看这部电影的观众说几句话吗？

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: This year we have a movie that features a battle between a lot of the legendary Pokémon that have starred in earlier movies on their own, so it's a real big-scale movie.
segments.translation: 今年我们的电影，是以许多过去曾在各自电影中担任主角的传说宝可梦之间的大战为看点的，所以是一部真正大规模的作品。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: As such, in a sense it's the culmination of the 18 years' worth of Pokémon movies I've been making, and I'd like you to look forward to how that aspect gets across.
segments.translation: 因此，从某种意义上说，它是我制作了18年的宝可梦电影的一个集大成之作，希望大家能期待这一点是如何体现出来的。

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: I'd like you all to go watch and enjoy the movie in the theater.
segments.translation: 希望大家都能去影院观看并享受这部电影。

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Pokémon the Movie XY: The Archdjinni of Rings: Hoopa/Pikachu and the Pokémon Musicians finally premieres tomorrow, Saturday July 18th!
segments.translation: 电影《宝可梦 XY 光环的超魔神 胡帕／皮卡丘与宝可梦音乐队》终于将在明天，7月18日星期六首映！

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Summer means Pokémon!
segments.translation: 夏天就是宝可梦！

segments.speaker: 汤山邦彦
segments.original: Go on an adventure with Hoopa, Pikachu and Satoshi in the theater!
segments.translation: 在影院与胡帕、皮卡丘和小智一起冒险吧！

segments.translation: “巴尔札：少年时期”设定图公开！（2015/7/31）

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.original: Barza grew up in Arkhē Valley together with Hoopa after its true powers had been confined.
segments.translation: 巴尔札在阿尔凯山谷与真实力量被封印后的胡帕一起长大。

segments.original: Here we're presenting the model sheets for him at that age.
segments.translation: 这里我们展示的是他那个时期的设定图。

segments.original: "Mary: Young"'s Model Sheets Appear! (2015/8/7)
segments.translation: “玛丽：少年时期”设定图公开！（2015/8/7）

segments.alt: A Special Movie Pre-Premiere Interview with Director Yuyama & Official Model Sheets

segments.original: Mary grew up in Arkhē Valley together with Hoopa after its true powers had been confined.
segments.translation: 玛丽在阿尔凯山谷与胡帕一同长大，当时胡帕真正的力量已被封印。

segments.original: Here we're presenting the model sheets for her at that age.
segments.translation: 这里我们展示的是她那个年龄段的设定图。

segments.original: She even plays pranks on others together with Hoopa, which she sometimes gets scolded for!?
segments.translation: 她甚至和胡帕一起捉弄别人，有时还会因此挨骂！？

segments.note: 盂兰盆节是日本夏季祭祖的节日，通常在8月中旬。
segments.original: Read It All in One Go During Obon Break! It Will Make You Want to Watch the Movie Once Again! A Special Reference Guide to the Pokemon Movie Channel! (2015/8/12)
segments.translation: 盂兰盆节假期一口气读完！会让你想再看一遍电影！宝可梦电影频道特别参考指南！（2015/8/12）

segments.original: The currently screening movie "The Archdjinni of Rings: Hoopa" is a huge hit!
segments.translation: 目前正在上映的电影《光环的超魔神 胡帕》大受欢迎！

segments.original: These are our recommendations for both those who are wondering whether to go see the movie or those who can't make up their mind if they want to see it again or not!
